<?php
const WEIGHTS=[100,-20,10,5,5,10,-20,100,-20,-50,-2,-2,-2,-2,-50,-20,10,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,10,5,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,5,5,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,5,10,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,10,-20,-50,-2,-2,-2,-2,-50,-20,100,-20,10,5,5,10,-20,100];
const TRANSFORMS=['rot90','rot180','rot270','mirror','flip','diag','anti'];
const ZERO=['NEW','DUMP','SHOW','SCORE','LEGAL','HISTORY','SHEET','STATS','EVAL','STABLE','SOLVE'];
const NUMERIC=['UNDO','REDO','HINT','PV','AI','ANALYZE','RANDOM','PERFT','DIVIDE'];
const ACTIVE=['FLIPS','MOVE','PLAY','HINT','PV','AI','SOLVE','AUTOPLAY','RANDOM','MC','DIVIDE'];
function other(string $s): string {
    return $s==='B'?'W':'B';
}
function squareName(int $p): string {
    return 'abcdefgh'[$p%8].(intdiv($p,8)+1);
}
function squareIndex(string $s): int {
    return ((int)$s[1]-1)*8+ord($s[0])-97;
}
function inside(int $r,int $c): bool {
    return $r>=0&&$r<8&&$c>=0&&$c<8;
}
function initial(): string {
    $b=str_repeat('.',64);
    $b[27]=$b[36]='W';
    $b[28]=$b[35]='B';
    return $b;
}
function flips(string $b,string $s,int $p): array {
    if($b[$p]!=='.')return [];
    $out=[];
    $row=intdiv($p,8);
    $col=$p%8;
    for($dr=-1;$dr<=1;$dr++)for($dc=-1;$dc<=1;$dc++){
        if(!$dr&&!$dc)continue;
        $r=$row+$dr;
        $c=$col+$dc;
        $line=[];
        while(inside($r,$c)&&$b[8*$r+$c]===other($s)){
            $line[]=8*$r+$c;
            $r+=$dr;
            $c+=$dc;
        }
        if($line&&inside($r,$c)&&$b[8*$r+$c]===$s)array_push($out,...$line);
    }
    sort($out,SORT_NUMERIC);
    return $out;
}
function legal(string $b,string $s): array {
    $ms=[];
    for($p=0;$p<64;$p++)if($b[$p]==='.'&&flips($b,$s,$p))$ms[]=$p;
    return $ms;
}
function place(string $b,string $s,int $p): string {
    foreach(flips($b,$s,$p) as $q)$b[$q]=$s;
    $b[$p]=$s;
    return $b;
}
function terminal(string $b): bool {
    return !legal($b,'B')&&!legal($b,'W');
}
function gameOver(string $b): string {
    $x=substr_count($b,'B');
    $y=substr_count($b,'W');
    return "game over B $x W $y ".($x>$y?'winner B':($x<$y?'winner W':'draw'));
}
function evaluate(string $b,string $s): array {
    $w=0;
    for($i=0;$i<64;$i++)$w+=$b[$i]===$s?WEIGHTS[$i]:($b[$i]===other($s)?-WEIGHTS[$i]:0);
    $own=count(legal($b,$s));
    $enemy=count(legal($b,other($s)));
    return [$w+10*($own-$enemy),$w,$own,$enemy];
}
function search(string $b,string $s,int $d): int {
    static $cache=[];
    $key=$b.$s.':'.$d;
    if(isset($cache[$key]))return $cache[$key];
    $ms=legal($b,$s);
    $o=other($s);
    if(!$ms&&!legal($b,$o))$v=($d<0?1:1000)*(substr_count($b,$s)-substr_count($b,$o));
    elseif($d===0)$v=evaluate($b,$s)[0];
    elseif(!$ms)$v=-search($b,$o,$d<0?-1:$d-1);
    else{
        $v=-1000000;
        foreach($ms as $p)$v=max($v,-search(place($b,$s,$p),$o,$d<0?-1:$d-1));
    }
    if(count($cache)>300000)$cache=[];
    return $cache[$key]=$v;
}
function ranked(string $b,string $s,int $d): array {
    $out=[];
    foreach(legal($b,$s) as $p)$out[]=[-search(place($b,$s,$p),other($s),$d<0?-1:$d-1),$p];
    usort($out,fn($a,$b)=>($b[0]<=>$a[0])?:($a[1]<=>$b[1]));
    return $out;
}
function variation(string $b,string $s,int $d): array {
    $steps=[];
    while($d!==0&&!terminal($b)){
        $ms=ranked($b,$s,$d);
        if($ms){
            $p=$ms[0][1];
            $steps[]=squareName($p);
            $b=place($b,$s,$p);
        }else $steps[]='pass';
        $s=other($s);
        if($d>0)$d--;
    }
    return [$steps,$b];
}
function perft(string $b,string $s,int $d): int {
    if(!$d)return 1;
    static $cache=[];
    $key=$b.$s.$d;
    if(isset($cache[$key]))return $cache[$key];
    $ms=legal($b,$s);
    $n=0;
    if(!$ms)$n=legal($b,other($s))?perft($b,other($s),$d-1):1;
    else foreach($ms as $p)$n+=perft(place($b,$s,$p),other($s),$d-1);
    if(count($cache)>200000)$cache=[];
    return $cache[$key]=$n;
}
function stable(string $b): array {
    $stable=array_fill(0,64,false);
    $axes=[[0,1],[1,0],[1,1],[1,-1]];
    while(true){
        $found=[];
        for($p=0;$p<64;$p++){
            if($b[$p]==='.'||$stable[$p])continue;
            $row=intdiv($p,8);
            $col=$p%8;
            $ok=true;
            foreach($axes as [$dr,$dc]){
                $full=true;
                $anchor=false;
                foreach([-1,1] as $sign){
                    $r=$row+$dr*$sign;
                    $c=$col+$dc*$sign;
                    if(!inside($r,$c)||($stable[8*$r+$c]&&$b[8*$r+$c]===$b[$p]))$anchor=true;
                    while(inside($r,$c)){
                        if($b[8*$r+$c]==='.')$full=false;
                        $r+=$dr*$sign;
                        $c+=$dc*$sign;
                    }
                }
                if(!$full&&!$anchor){
                    $ok=false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if($ok)$found[]=$p;
        }
        if(!$found)break;
        foreach($found as $p)$stable[$p]=true;
    }
    $black=$white=0;
    foreach($stable as $p=>$yes)if($yes){
        if($b[$p]==='B')$black++;
        else $white++;
    }
    return [$black,$white];
}
function transform(int $p,string $op): int {
    $r=intdiv($p,8);
    $c=$p%8;
    return match($op){
        'rot90'=>8*$c+7-$r,'rot180'=>63-$p,'rot270'=>8*(7-$c)+$r,'mirror'=>8*$r+7-$c,'flip'=>8*(7-$r)+$c,'diag'=>8*$c+$r,default=>8*(7-$c)+7-$r
    };
}
function transformBoard(string $b,string $op): string {
    $a=str_repeat('.',64);
    for($p=0;$p<64;$p++)$a[transform($p,$op)]=$b[$p];
    return $a;
}
class Minstd {
    function __construct(private int $value){
    }
    function draw(): int {
        return $this->value=$this->value*48271%2147483647;
    }
}
function randomGame(string $b,string $s,Minstd $rng): string {
    while(true){
        $ms=legal($b,$s);
        if($ms)$b=place($b,$s,$ms[$rng->draw()%count($ms)]);
        elseif(!legal($b,other($s)))return $b;
        $s=other($s);
    }
}
function average(int $f,int $n): string {
    $v=intdiv(100*$f,$n);
    return intdiv($v,100).'.'.str_pad((string)($v%100),2,'0',STR_PAD_LEFT);
}
class Othello {
    private string $board;
    private string $side;
    private bool $over;
    private array $history=[];
    private array $redo=[];
    function __construct(){
        $this->reset();
    }
    function reset(): void {
        $this->board=initial();
        $this->side='B';
        $this->over=false;
        $this->history=[];
        $this->redo=[];
    }
    function emit(...$xs): void {
        echo implode(' ',$xs),"\n";
    }
    function snapshot(): array {
        return [$this->board,$this->side,$this->over];
    }
    function restore(array $p): void {
        [$this->board,$this->side,$this->over]=$p;
    }
    function status(): string {
        return $this->over?gameOver($this->board):$this->side.' to move';
    }
    function adjust(bool $quiet=false): bool {
        if(legal($this->board,$this->side))return false;
        if(legal($this->board,other($this->side))){
            if(!$quiet)$this->emit($this->side,'passes');
            $this->side=other($this->side);
            return true;
        }
        $this->over=true;
        if(!$quiet)$this->emit(gameOver($this->board));
        return false;
    }
    function move(int $p,bool $quiet=false,?int $value=null): bool {
        $before=$this->snapshot();
        $s=$this->side;
        $k=count(flips($this->board,$s,$p));
        $this->board=place($this->board,$s,$p);
        if(!$quiet)$this->emit($s,squareName($p),'flips',$k,...($value===null?[]:['value',$value]));
        $this->side=other($s);
        $passed=$this->adjust($quiet);
        $this->history[]=['side'=>$s,'square'=>$p,'count'=>$k,'passed'=>$passed,'before'=>$before,'after'=>$this->snapshot()];
        $this->redo=[];
        return $passed;
    }
    function reason(int $p): string {
        return $this->over?'game over':($this->board[$p]!=='.'?'occupied':(!flips($this->board,$this->side,$p)?'no flips':''));
    }
    function record(string $text): void {
        $e=new Othello();
        $ps=[];
        $passes=0;
        foreach(str_split($text,2) as $i=>$s){
            $p=squareIndex($s);
            $why=$e->reason($p);
            if($why!==''){
                $this->emit('ILLEGAL move',$i+1,$s,$why);
                return;
            }
            $ps[]=$p;
            $passes+=(int)$e->move($p,true);
        }
        $this->restore($e->snapshot());
        $this->history=$e->history;
        $this->redo=[];
        $op=['f5'=>'','e6'=>'diag','d3'=>'anti','c4'=>'rot180'][squareName($ps[0])];
        $normal='';
        foreach($ps as $p)$normal.=squareName($op===''?$p:transform($p,$op));
        $this->emit('record',count($ps),'moves',$passes,'passes');
        $this->emit('normal',$normal);
        $this->emit($this->status());
    }
    function sheet(): void {
        $fields=str_split($this->history?$this->history[0]['before'][0]:$this->board);
        foreach($this->history as $i=>$r)$fields[$r['square']]=(string)($i+1);
        $this->emit(' '.implode('',array_map(fn($s)=>str_pad($s,3,' ',STR_PAD_LEFT),str_split('abcdefgh'))));
        for($r=0;$r<8;$r++)$this->emit(($r+1).implode('',array_map(fn($s)=>str_pad($s,3,' ',STR_PAD_LEFT),array_slice($fields,8*$r,8))));
    }
    function stats(): void {
        $all=$this->history;
        $total=array_sum(array_column($all,'count'));
        if(!$all)$this->emit('moves 0');
        else $this->emit('moves',count($all),'flips',$total,'avg',average($total,count($all)),'passes',count(array_filter($all,fn($r)=>$r['passed'])));
        foreach(['B','W'] as $s){
            $rows=array_values(array_filter($all,fn($r)=>$r['side']===$s));
            if(!$rows){
                $this->emit($s,'moves 0');
                continue;
            }
            $sum=array_sum(array_column($rows,'count'));
            $max=max(array_column($rows,'count'));
            $first=array_values(array_filter($rows,fn($r)=>$r['count']===$max))[0];
            $corners=count(array_filter($rows,fn($r)=>in_array($r['square'],[0,7,56,63],true)));
            $this->emit($s,'moves',count($rows),'flips',$sum,'avg',average($sum,count($rows)),'max',$max,squareName($first['square']),'corners',$corners);
        }
    }
    function autoplay(int $black,int $white,int $seed=0): void {
        $rng=$seed?new Minstd($seed):null;
        $ps=[];
        $passes=0;
        while(!$this->over){
            $ms=legal($this->board,$this->side);
            $p=$rng?$ms[$rng->draw()%count($ms)]:ranked($this->board,$this->side,$this->side==='B'?$black:$white)[0][1];
            $ps[]=squareName($p);
            $passes+=(int)$this->move($p,true);
        }
        $this->emit($rng?'random':'autoplay',count($ps),'moves',$passes,'passes');
        $this->emit('moves',implode('',$ps));
        $this->emit(gameOver($this->board));
    }
    function monteCarlo(int $k,int $seed): void {
        $rng=new Minstd($seed);
        $best=$bp=-1;
        foreach(legal($this->board,$this->side) as $p){
            $w=$d=$l=0;
            $start=place($this->board,$this->side,$p);
            for($i=0;$i<$k;$i++){
                $b=randomGame($start,other($this->side),$rng);
                $diff=substr_count($b,$this->side)-substr_count($b,other($this->side));
                if($diff>0)$w++;
                elseif($diff<0)$l++;
                else $d++;
            }
            $this->emit(squareName($p),$w,$d,$l);
            if(2*$w+$d>$best){
                $best=2*$w+$d;
                $bp=$p;
            }
        }
        $this->emit('best',squareName($bp),$best);
    }
    function execute(string $text): void {
        $a=explode(' ',$text);
        $cmd=array_shift($a);
        $error='';
        $commands=array_merge(ZERO,NUMERIC,['LOAD','TRANSFORM','AUTOPLAY','MC','FLIPS','MOVE','PLAY','RECORD']);
        if(!in_array($cmd,$commands,true))$error='unknown command';
        elseif($cmd==='LOAD'){
            if(count($a)!==2||!preg_match('/^[.BW]{64}$/D',$a[0])||!in_array($a[1],['B','W'],true))$error='bad board';
        }
        elseif(in_array($cmd,['MOVE','FLIPS'],true)){
            $error=count($a)!==1?'bad arguments':(!preg_match('/^[a-h][1-8]$/D',$a[0])?'bad square':'');
        }
        elseif(in_array($cmd,['PLAY','RECORD'],true)){
            $error=count($a)!==1?'bad arguments':(strlen($a[0])>120||!preg_match('/^([a-h][1-8])+$/D',$a[0])?'bad record':'');
        }
        elseif(in_array($cmd,ZERO,true)){
            if($a)$error='bad arguments';
        }
        elseif($cmd==='TRANSFORM'){
            if(count($a)!==1||!in_array($a[0],TRANSFORMS,true))$error='bad arguments';
        }
        else {
            $expected=in_array($cmd,['AUTOPLAY','MC'],true)?2:1;
            $valid=count($a)===$expected;
            foreach($a as $s)if(!preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/D',$s))$valid=false;
            if($valid){
                $ns=array_map('intval',$a);
                $n=$ns[0];
                $valid=match($cmd){
                    'AUTOPLAY'=>$n>=1&&$n<=4&&$ns[1]>=1&&$ns[1]<=4,'HINT','PV','AI','ANALYZE'=>$n>=1&&$n<=4,'PERFT','DIVIDE'=>$n>=1&&$n<=8,'MC'=>$n>=1&&$n<=100&&$ns[1]>=1&&$ns[1]<=2147483646,'RANDOM'=>$n>=1&&$n<=2147483646,default=>$n>=1
                };
            }
            if(!$valid)$error='bad arguments';
        }
        if($error!==''){
            $this->emit('ERROR',$error);
            return;
        }
        if($this->over&&in_array($cmd,ACTIVE,true)){
            $this->emit('ERROR game over');
            return;
        }
        $n=(int)($a[0]??0);
        switch($cmd){
            case 'NEW':$this->reset();
            $this->emit('OK');
            break;
            case 'LOAD':$this->board=$a[0];
            $this->side=$a[1];
            $this->over=false;
            $this->history=[];
            $this->redo=[];
            $this->emit('OK');
            $this->adjust();
            break;
            case 'DUMP':$this->emit('board',$this->board,$this->side);
            break;
            case 'SHOW':$this->emit('  a b c d e f g h');
            $ms=$this->over?[]:legal($this->board,$this->side);
            for($r=0;$r<8;$r++){
                $row=[$r+1];
                for($c=0;$c<8;$c++)$row[]=in_array(8*$r+$c,$ms,true)?'*':$this->board[8*$r+$c];
                $this->emit(...$row);
            }
            $this->emit($this->status());
            break;
            case 'SCORE':$this->emit('score B',substr_count($this->board,'B'),'W',substr_count($this->board,'W'),'empty',substr_count($this->board,'.'));
            break;
            case 'LEGAL':$ms=$this->over?[]:legal($this->board,$this->side);
            $this->emit('legal',count($ms),...array_map('squareName',$ms));
            break;
            case 'MOVE':case 'FLIPS':$p=squareIndex($a[0]);
            $why=$this->reason($p);
            if($why!=='')$this->emit('ILLEGAL',$why);
            elseif($cmd==='MOVE')$this->move($p);
            else{
                $f=flips($this->board,$this->side,$p);
                $this->emit('flips',$a[0],count($f),...array_map('squareName',$f));
            }
            break;
            case 'PLAY':foreach(str_split($a[0],2) as $i=>$s){
                $p=squareIndex($s);
                $why=$this->reason($p);
                if($why!==''){
                    $this->emit('ILLEGAL move',$i+1,$s,$why);
                    break;
                }
                $this->move($p);
            }
            break;
            case 'RECORD':$this->record($a[0]);
            break;
            case 'UNDO':if($n>count($this->history))$this->emit('ERROR cannot undo');
            else{
                $removed=array_splice($this->history,-$n);
                $this->restore($removed[0]['before']);
                $this->redo=array_merge($removed,$this->redo);
                $this->emit($this->status());
            }
            break;
            case 'REDO':if($n>count($this->redo))$this->emit('ERROR cannot redo');
            else{
                $added=array_splice($this->redo,0,$n);
                array_push($this->history,...$added);
                $this->restore($added[count($added)-1]['after']);
                $this->emit($this->status());
            }
            break;
            case 'HISTORY':$this->emit('history',count($this->history));
            foreach($this->history as $i=>$r)$this->emit($i+1,$r['side'],squareName($r['square']),$r['count'],...($r['passed']?['pass']:[]));
            break;
            case 'SHEET':$this->sheet();
            break;
            case 'STATS':$this->stats();
            break;
            case 'TRANSFORM':$op=$a[0];
            $this->board=transformBoard($this->board,$op);
            $tr=function($r)use($op){
                $r['square']=transform($r['square'],$op);
                $r['before'][0]=transformBoard($r['before'][0],$op);
                $r['after'][0]=transformBoard($r['after'][0],$op);
                return $r;
            };
            $this->history=array_map($tr,$this->history);
            $this->redo=array_map($tr,$this->redo);
            $this->emit('OK');
            break;
            case 'EVAL':[$v,$w,$x,$y]=evaluate($this->board,$this->side);
            $this->emit('eval',$v,'weights',$w,'mobility',$x,$y);
            break;
            case 'STABLE':[$b,$w]=stable($this->board);
            $this->emit('stable B',$b,'W',$w);
            break;
            case 'HINT':foreach(ranked($this->board,$this->side,$n) as [$v,$p])$this->emit(squareName($p),$v);
            break;
            case 'PV':[$steps]=variation($this->board,$this->side,$n);
            $this->emit('pv',search($this->board,$this->side,$n),...$steps);
            break;
            case 'AI':[$v,$p]=ranked($this->board,$this->side,$n)[0];
            $this->move($p,false,$v);
            break;
            case 'ANALYZE':$loss=['B'=>0,'W'=>0];
            foreach($this->history as $i=>$r){
                $rows=ranked($r['before'][0],$r['side'],$n);
                [$best,$bp]=$rows[0];
                foreach($rows as [$value,$p])if($p===$r['square']){
                    $v=$value;
                    break;
                }
                $loss[$r['side']]+=$best-$v;
                $this->emit($i+1,$r['side'],squareName($r['square']),$v,'best',squareName($bp),$best);
            }
            $this->emit('loss B',$loss['B'],'W',$loss['W']);
            break;
            case 'SOLVE':if(substr_count($this->board,'.')>=9)$this->emit('ERROR too many empties');
            else{
                foreach(ranked($this->board,$this->side,-1) as [$v,$p])$this->emit(squareName($p),$v);
                [$steps,$b]=variation($this->board,$this->side,-1);
                $this->emit('line',...$steps);
                $this->emit('final B',substr_count($b,'B'),'W',substr_count($b,'W'));
            }
            break;
            case 'AUTOPLAY':$this->autoplay($n,(int)$a[1]);
            break;
            case 'RANDOM':$this->autoplay(0,0,$n);
            break;
            case 'MC':$this->monteCarlo($n,(int)$a[1]);
            break;
            case 'PERFT':$this->emit('perft',$n,perft($this->board,$this->side,$n));
            break;
            case 'DIVIDE':$total=0;
            foreach(legal($this->board,$this->side) as $p){
                $v=perft(place($this->board,$this->side,$p),other($this->side),$n-1);
                $this->emit(squareName($p),$v);
                $total+=$v;
            }
            $this->emit('total',$total);
            break;
        }
    }
}
$engine=new Othello();
$n=(int)trim(fgets(STDIN));
for($i=0;$i<$n;$i++)$engine->execute(rtrim(fgets(STDIN),"\r\n"));
